execution_view.completeness_scope: Completeness applies to the selected execution view. Remaining design IDs remain planned.
execution_view.fresh_target_meaning: Suite targets excluding reused dependencies; this inventory does not inspect current judging progress.

full_design.shared_response_note: The base contest responses enter both vendor and stance analyses; they are the same 384 responses.

execution_view.selection_reason: User-requested execution order; no outcome-based selection.
execution_view.sequential_dependencies: Base and matched joint results remain comparison dependencies; only blocked targets need fresh sequential scoring.

verification_scope: Collector attestations plus RUN/SUCCESS/battery hashes and response file sizes. No response or judgment contents read; downstream analysis verifies full response bytes. Explicit terminal evidence manifests and frozen artifact hashes verified without parsing judgment or diagnostic text.
